title: Transfigure
description:
Add [gold]Replay[/gold] to a card in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
It costs an extra 1 Energy.
notes: Selecting a card from your hand adds Replay to it and increases its energy cost by 1 this combat. Only affects cards that don't cost X and have a cost ≥ 0. On upgrade, removes the Exhaust keyword.
